title: Work in progress — ARTPARK

<script>
/* Countdown: set the date in data-ready-by on <body> (India time if no zone given). */
(function(){var raw=document.body.getAttribute('data-ready-by')||'2026-11-18T18:00';
var t=Date.parse(/[zZ]|[+-]\d\d:?\d\d$/.test(raw)?raw:raw+'+05:30');
function pad(n){return String(n).padStart(2,'0');}
function tick(){var left=Math.max(0,(isNaN(t)?0:t)-Date.now());
var q=function(k){return document.querySelector('[data-cd="'+k+'"]');};
q('d').textContent=pad(Math.floor(left/864e5));q('h').textContent=pad(Math.floor(left/36e5)%24);
q('m').textContent=pad(Math.floor(left/6e4)%60);q('s').textContent=pad(Math.floor(left/1e3)%60);
document.querySelector('[data-cd-running]').hidden=left<=0;document.querySelector('[data-cd-done]').hidden=left>0;}
tick();setInterval(tick,1000);})();
</script>
